NeFS archive support uses VictorBush.Ego.NefsLib 0.7.1 from the user's installed
NefsEdit 0.7.1 distribution. NeFS Edit is MIT licensed (LICENSE-NefsEdit.txt).
Official source: https://github.com/victorbush/ego.nefsedit

Bundled dependencies from that same distribution:
- Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions (Microsoft; MIT)
- System.IO.Abstractions / TestableIO.System.IO.Abstractions / Wrappers
  (TestableIO contributors; MIT)
- Testably.Abstractions.FileSystem.Interface (Testably contributors; MIT)

The DLLs are bundled to make archive support available without installation.
No game data is included.
